uiBuilder.label: Leaflet Map
uiBuilder.description: Renders points on an interactive Leaflet map from JSON coordinate data

properties.name: centerLat
properties.label: Center latitude
properties.description: Initial map center latitude, used before points render (ignored once autoFit runs)

properties.name: centerLng
properties.label: Center longitude
properties.description: Initial map center longitude, used before points render (ignored once autoFit runs)

properties.name: zoomLevel
properties.label: Zoom level
properties.description: Initial map zoom level, used before points render (ignored once autoFit runs)

properties.name: tileLayerUrl
properties.label: Tile layer URL
properties.description: Tile provider URL template, e.g. an internal tile server or Mapbox

properties.name: attribution
properties.label: Attribution
properties.description: Map attribution text/HTML shown in the corner of the map

properties.name: autoFit
properties.label: Auto-fit to points
properties.description: When true, the map zooms/pans to fit all supplied points automatically

properties.name: enableAreaSelect
properties.label: Enable area select
properties.description: Show a "Draw area" control that lets the user trace a shape on the map and select the points inside it

actions.name: AREA_SELECTED
actions.label: Area selected
actions.description: Fires after the user finishes drawing a shape on the map, with the points found inside it

payload.name: points
payload.description: The point objects (lat, lng, label, ...) that fall inside the drawn area

payload.name: polygon
payload.description: The {lat, lng} vertices describing the drawn area
